title: OHC common definitions
description: Shared types (names starting with a capital letter) and controlled vocabularies (names starting with a lowercase letter). Vocabulary $defs are generated from spec/catalogs by tools/check.py --gen-enums and must equal the catalogs (S-4): one $def per catalog file named after the file (without .json); a catalog that declares lists gets one $def per list, named <catalog>.<list>, holding the codes whose list member equals that name, in file order. A closed list becomes {"enum": [...]}; an open list becomes {"anyOf": [{"enum": [...]}, {"$ref": "#/$defs/LocalCode"}]}. Catalogs with generatesEnum false produce no $def. Every enumeration in OHC schemas is a $ref to one of these $defs. This schema only holds $defs and validates no document.

LangText.description: A text in English (reference language) and Russian.

LocalId.description: A record or party id, unique within a context and never reused. The stricter R-I1 pattern (kind prefix, then counter, ULID or UUID) is a SHOULD, checked as warning W-ID1.

URI.description: An absolute URI, for example urn:ohc:..., urn:uuid:..., did:... or https://...

LocalCode.description: A local vocabulary code x-<namespace>:<code>, defined in Context.vocabulary. Readers treat unknown x- codes as opaque and never infer from them.

DateTime.description: An RFC 3339 date-time with an offset.

DateOrDateTime.description: A date or an RFC 3339 date-time.

Duration.description: An ISO 8601 duration, for example P3M or PT30M.

Sha256Hex.description: A SHA-256 value as 64 lowercase hex characters.

Alias.description: A pairwise alias of the subject for one grantee (urn:ohc:alias: plus 26 lowercase characters).

Handle.description: A per-grant HMAC handle ("hmac:" plus base64url).

Path.description: A relative package path: no leading /, no backslash, no .. segment, no colon (ODE's path rule).

Ref.description: A reference: a local id, or a cross-context reference that is never followed.

CrossRef.description: A cross-context reference <contextId>#<recordId>. Never followed by the checker.

Actor.description: Who: "subject" (the person the context is about), "holder" (the context's holder under its declared policy), or a Party id listed in Context.parties. A Part is never an actor (R-P2).

Interval.description: A time interval; until is exclusive.

Selector.description: A stored span selector, modelled on W3C Web Annotation selectors. The text-quote selector exists only in served excerpts and is never stored.

oneOf.description: Unicode code points over the NFC text, 0-based, end exclusive.
A page, optionally with a region.

region.description: A region as fractions 0..1 of the page.

ServedSelector.description: A selector in served excerpts: any stored selector, or a text-quote selector generated at serve time.

oneOf.description: Unicode code points over the NFC text, 0-based, end exclusive.
A page, optionally with a region.

region.description: A region as fractions 0..1 of the page.

Span.description: Points into a Source. Records never store quoted text or quote digests (R-V1).

Ground.description: What a reading rests on: exactly one of ref and span.

Confidence.description: A confidence value with its semantics. A missing confidence is never 0 (R-N2).

ImportedFrom.description: Where an imported record came from. derivedFields lists fields the importer computed rather than copied.

GeneratedBy.description: The software and rule that produced a derived record.

GrantSelector.description: AND across fields, OR within a field. A selector with all and nothing else is the wildcard.

Predicate.description: A claim predicate: a predicate code, a relationship kind (facet relationship), or a local x- code.

Extensions.description: Extensions. Keys match ODE's regex; content is preserved JCS-equal. Defined keys: gum.import, gum.export, vc.credential, jscontact.extra, ohc.test-data.

OdeRef.description: An ODE object reference. Not identity and not access.

Disclosure.description: A disclosure change carried by a restrict or relax Review.

Envelope.description: The content-record envelope, defined once. Every content-record schema includes these members by reference to Envelope/properties.

kind.description: Implied by the collection in the single document; required in package JSONL and in messages (R-S2).

origin.description: How the content came to be. Set once; never changes (R-O1).

assertedBy.description: Whose statement, reading or record this is.

recordedAt.description: Knowledge time: when it entered this context. Import and copy never change it (R-T4).

recordedBy.description: Who wrote it into the context. Defaults to assertedBy.

underGrant.description: INF-1: the Grant the writer used, required when the writer is neither the subject nor a steward in scope.

purpose.description: Required with underGrant; one of the Grant's purposes.

formulatedAt.description: When the content was first formulated; may be earlier than recordedAt (R-T5b).

supersedes.description: An earlier record of the same kind that this one replaces (R-V2).

epistemic.description: Initial epistemic status; later changes are Reviews reassess.

sensitivity.description: Stored tier; the effective tier is computed by C3.

derivedFrom.description: Records this one was computed from; required when origin is derived.

synthetic.description: MUST be true in published examples (X-1).

note.description: A free remark by the writer. Never used for inference.

EnvelopeRules.description: Conditional rules of the envelope: importedFrom when origin is imported; generatedBy (with method) and derivedFrom when origin is derived; purpose with underGrant.
